translation.name: Reꞌ Lokꞌ Laj Hu̱j Wilic wi̱ꞌ Ribiral i Jesus

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: Reꞌ ribiral i Jesus xitzꞌihmbaj i Maꞌ Tiyoh

content: Reꞌ ripajaric ricapew-bal i Jesusxbanjic ruꞌum aj Yahm

Nok chalanak chic i Lokꞌ laj rUxlabal i Dios ru̱cꞌ i Jesus, xcꞌamaric je ruꞌum i Lokꞌ laj Uxlabal ar pan jenaj yeꞌa̱b chik yu̱kꞌ reꞌ maꞌxta wi̱ꞌ patanel reꞌ xwihꞌic wi̱ꞌ chi naripajaric ruꞌum aj Yahm.
Ar ajic nok yohbal woꞌ chic wach ricꞌahric xjohtic cho Jesus chiri̱j chi ribanam chic lok caꞌwinak (40) kꞌi̱j chi maꞌ ribanam ta riwaꞌ riha̱ꞌ,
reꞌ aj Yahm jeꞌ wili xponic rikꞌor reh xa chi pajbal reh: «Reꞌ hat Jesus wilic rajawric akꞌorbal ruꞌum nok hat rAcꞌu̱n i Dios. Chakꞌor reh abaj wili kꞌuruꞌ chi mikrok caxlan wiꞌc, nqui reh.
Raj laꞌ Jesus jeꞌ wili ricꞌuꞌljic xiban: «Coric wilic rajawric nikꞌorbal, xa reꞌ laꞌ maꞌxta nibiram kꞌoric chawach maj pa riCꞌuhbal i Dios tzꞌihmbimaj chi jeꞌ wili:

content.text: “Reꞌ cꞌacharel reh chi naricꞌacharic curman chi naribanam riwaꞌ,
xa reꞌ laꞌ til kꞌe̱ꞌ woꞌ chic curman chi naribiram haj wilic rikꞌor i Dios reh chi naricꞌacharic chi suk ru̱cꞌ, nqui rikꞌor, nqui ricꞌuꞌljic xiban.

content: Chiri̱j chic ruꞌ xcꞌamaric woꞌ chic je Jesus ruꞌum aj Yahm ar chipam tinamit Jerusalen reꞌ xichih i Dios chi ar narilokꞌonjic wach. Ar xpahbabjic china̱ i maꞌ laj tzꞌak nsutunic ri̱j i Lokꞌ laj Pa̱t reꞌ nlokꞌonjic wi̱ꞌ wach i Dios

eh jeꞌ woꞌ chic wili xkꞌormojic reh ruꞌum aj Yahm: «Reꞌ hat Jesus rAcꞌu̱n i Dios, reꞌ take raj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch quichaꞌjanic aweh maj pan Lokꞌ laj Hu̱j reꞌ wilic wi̱ꞌ i riCꞌuhbal i Dios jeꞌ wili tzꞌihmbimaj:

content.text: “Reꞌ Dios eritakꞌa̱ꞌ cho take raj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch chi etichalic quichaꞌjej i hat racꞌu̱n, nqui tzꞌihmbimaj.

content: «Jeꞌ woꞌ chic tzꞌihmbimaj woꞌ chi jeꞌ wili:

content.text: “Wi ta nak etikꞌehbic jok wach acꞌal reꞌ take reꞌ etiquicꞌul pan te̱w reh chi maꞌ eta nachꞌey awi̱b wach abaj, nqui tzꞌihmbimaj.

content: «Chacut jok awi̱b kꞌuruꞌ eh ru̱cꞌ reꞌreꞌ encꞌutunic chi til coric i chiꞌnchel reꞌreꞌ, nqui reh Jesus.
Reꞌ Jesus jeꞌ wili xikꞌor reh: «Coric xakꞌor, xa reꞌ laꞌ maꞌ riyew ta ri̱b chi enipaj i Dios maj jeꞌ wili tzꞌihmbimaj chipam i Lokꞌ laj Hu̱j reꞌ wilic wi̱ꞌ riCꞌuhbal i Dios:

content.text: “Ma̱yew chi pajaric awAja̱w Dios, nqui tzꞌihmbimaj, nqui Jesus.

content: Jeꞌ woꞌ chic, ar china̱ i jenaj yu̱kꞌ kꞌe̱ꞌ nahtil na̱ reꞌ xcꞌamaric je wi̱ꞌ i Jesus, reꞌ aj Yahm xicꞌuhtaj reh nicꞌ nimal take nimak wach tinamit wilque̱b wach acꞌal chꞌi̱l quibihomal
eh jeꞌ wili xikꞌor reh Jesus: «Chaxucꞌa̱ꞌ awi̱b chi nilokꞌonjic eh enikꞌahsaj pan akꞌab chiꞌnchel take reꞌreꞌ reh chi enakꞌat kꞌoric chi quina̱, nqui xikꞌor reh.
Reꞌ Jesus jeꞌ woꞌ chic wili xikꞌor reh aj Yahm: «Coric nakꞌor, xa reꞌ laꞌ maꞌxta ca̱t nilokꞌem maj pa riCꞌuhbal i Dios tzꞌihmbimaj chi jeꞌ wili:

content.text: “Xa reꞌ woꞌ Ajabe̱s Dios na̱lokꞌem wach
eh xa chiwach woꞌ reꞌ naxucꞌa̱b awi̱b, nqui tzꞌihmbimaj.

content: «Telen aj chi niwach, maꞌ nwilow chic awach, nqui reh.
Chi jeꞌ aj reꞌ, reꞌ aj Yahm xicana̱ꞌ cahnok i Jesus eh chiri̱j chic reꞌ xicꞌulic lok take raj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch i Dios chi ritobjic.
Reꞌ ripꞌuturic ricꞌuhbalanici Jesus pa riyukꞌul i Calile̱ya
Nok ribiram chic Jesus chi reꞌ Wa̱n aj kahsem haꞌ xcojoric pan che̱ꞌ ruꞌum Hero̱res, xsoljic woꞌ chic je pa riyukꞌul Calile̱ya,

ar pan tinamit Nasaret, reꞌ cok ruꞌ maꞌ xcahnic ta chi junpech chipam i tinamit reꞌreꞌ xelic laꞌ je ar eh xo̱j wihꞌok chipam i tinamit reꞌ Capernahum ribihnal reꞌ wilic chi chi̱ꞌ haꞌ. Ru̱cꞌ aj ricahnic chi cꞌacharic chipam i tinamit reꞌreꞌ, reꞌ wilic chipam i yukꞌul reꞌ quicꞌacharic wi̱ꞌ take ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho Sawulon chꞌi̱l i Neptalih,
xponic wach reꞌ xikꞌor cho i aj kꞌorol riCꞌuhbal i Dios, reꞌ maꞌ Isayi̱yas ribihnal, najtir kꞌi̱j chiri̱j i yukꞌul reꞌreꞌ. Reꞌreꞌ jeꞌ wili xikꞌor cho:

content.text: “Ar chipam i yukꞌul quicꞌacharic wi̱ꞌ take ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho Sawulon chꞌi̱l i Neptalih,
reꞌ wilic chi chi̱ꞌ haꞌ pa risecꞌa̱j i nim ro̱k haꞌ Jortan, Calile̱ya ribihnal,
reꞌ wilque̱b woꞌ wi̱ꞌ qꞌuihal take cꞌacharel maꞌ reꞌ ta ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho maꞌ Israhel,
kꞌe̱ꞌ rinimal sukquil cꞌuxlis xchalic cu̱cꞌ i tinamit
xa jeꞌ na ricab nok reꞌ take behel wilque̱b pan kꞌekom akꞌab chi xa qꞌuisi̱n nak chic maꞌ quicansjic,
kꞌe̱ꞌ nansukbic quicꞌux nanquilow woꞌ chic wach risakomil i kꞌi̱j, nqui xikꞌor cho.

content: Reꞌ Jesus xiyukꞌej takepe̱t raj tahkanel

Ar aj chipam i tinamit Capernahum xa reꞌ woꞌ ti xponic i Jesus, jeꞌ wili pꞌuht rikꞌorom queh tinamit: «Chajal tak wach anoꞌjbal ruꞌum nok xirak chic rikꞌijil chi reꞌ Dios naripꞌutum woꞌ chic kꞌatoj kꞌoric chi quina̱ take cꞌacharel, nqui queh.

Chipam woꞌ tinamit reꞌreꞌ, reꞌ Jesus pꞌuht rihchꞌiljic cuꞌum take pe̱t raj tahkanel chi jeꞌ wili riwi̱ꞌ: Junpech nok cꞌahchiꞌ risutem chi̱ꞌ i nim laj haꞌ wilic ar pa riyukꞌul Calile̱ya, reꞌreꞌ xilow quiwach take quib aj car cꞌahchiꞌ quicutum jok pan haꞌ i quiyaꞌl chopbal quica̱r. Reꞌ take reꞌ xa quicha̱kꞌ qui̱b eh jeꞌ wili quibihnal: Reꞌ Simon reꞌ ribihnej woꞌ chi Luch eh chꞌi̱l i Tirix.

Naxikꞌoꞌrjic ar ruꞌum i Jesus, jeꞌ wili xkꞌormojic queh: «Tak chiwi̱j chi na̱banam tak chi waj tahkanel. Chi jelow-bal i chopoj car naꞌn tak, reꞌ hin eniban chi reꞌ chic take awas acha̱kꞌ enaꞌn tak chi enquichop quicꞌux chiwi̱j i hin, nqui Jesus queh.
Naxquibiraj chi jeꞌ reꞌ, reꞌ take quib reꞌreꞌ chi jumehkꞌil xquicana̱ꞌ cho quicamaj chi aj chopol car take eh xiꞌo̱j chiri̱j i Jesus chi raj tahkanel.

Chiri̱j i wili nok cꞌahchiꞌ ritikim juꞌ ribe̱h, reꞌ Jesus xo̱j rirak take quib chic chi aj car reꞌ xa quicha̱kꞌ woꞌ qui̱b jeꞌ wili quibihnal: Reꞌ Jaco̱wo chꞌi̱l i Wa̱n. Reꞌ take reꞌ chꞌi̱l i caja̱w, reꞌ Sewere̱yo ribihnal, ar wilque̱b chipam i cano̱wa reꞌ cꞌahchiꞌ quicꞌojem wi̱ꞌ wach i quiyaꞌl chopbal quica̱r naxkꞌormojic queh ruꞌum Jesus chi naquipahbabjic chi raj tahkanel chic take wi xiꞌoquic chi ritahkaljic,
xa chiwach woꞌ ti juncꞌam reꞌreꞌ xquicana̱ꞌ cahnok i cano̱wa reꞌ ncamanic queh chi aj chopol car eh nok quichꞌakam chic je qui̱b ru̱cꞌ caja̱w, xiꞌo̱j chiri̱j i Jesus.

Jeꞌ reꞌ ajic chi cꞌahchiꞌ ribehem pa̱m riyukꞌul i Calile̱ya richꞌi̱l chic take raj tahkanel jeꞌ ru̱cꞌ riyukꞌem chic take, reꞌ Jesus xiban i cꞌuhtunic chipam take pa̱t ntijiljic wi̱ꞌ ri̱j i Cꞌuhbal Yeꞌo̱j reh Moyses. Ar woꞌ chipam i yukꞌul reꞌreꞌ, maꞌ xa reꞌ ta rikꞌormojic queh take cꞌacharel i holohic laj kꞌoric chi reꞌ Dios reꞌ nkꞌatbic kꞌoric ra̱j richopom quina̱ jeꞌ laꞌ woꞌ xesaj woꞌ lok xa chaj bih jaric quitiꞌquilal take yowaꞌi̱b xicꞌamaric cho ru̱cꞌ.

Maꞌ xa ta reꞌ take cꞌacharel reꞌreꞌ, qꞌuihal laꞌ take aj Si̱rya naxponic ribiral pan quiyukꞌul chiri̱j nicꞌ nimal take esenic yaꞌbilal riban Jesus, xquicꞌam cho quiyowaꞌi̱b reh chi naresmejic lok quiyaꞌbilal ruꞌum. Jeꞌ reꞌ ajic, chiꞌnchel take cꞌacharel jeꞌ ru̱cꞌ si̱c take chꞌi̱l take maꞌ suk ta pa̱m quina̱ chꞌi̱l woꞌ take wilic maꞌ tob laj uxlabal cu̱cꞌ, xicowsjic ruꞌum Jesus.

Chi jeꞌ aj reꞌ, qꞌuihal take cꞌacharel chalanak take pan tinamit Jerusalen chꞌi̱l pan toco̱m chic tinamit wilque̱b pa riyukꞌul Jure̱ya, pa riyukꞌul Calile̱ya, pa riyukꞌul Reca̱polis chꞌi̱l pa riyukꞌul i Pere̱ya reꞌ wilic chi juntar nim ro̱k haꞌ Jortan, xquitahkej je Jesus.
